Name: FS - Traveller's Attire
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/CT1Gbdw.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Traveller's Attire is a small [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack which adds several recolorable cloaks and hoods accessories via the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url] tool. Also includes some animated glowing eyes, which pair nicely with the dark hood.



[/size][img]https://imgur.com/uAFtCZv.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://imgur.com/r5yNVaC.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/sVMUY49.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/WshjJcH.png[/img]




[img]https://imgur.com/fP5yPeU.png[/img]
[b][size=3]How do I wear one of these cloaks?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "accessories" button.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]How do I wear one of these hoods?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "hats" button.[/size]
[/list]
